notes: Clear playlist and Delete all songs work now. Both used to remove nothing and still say Deleted, because they answered the Albums tab while drawn in the playlist one. Undo is one tap away.
Deleting songs asks in the app instead of a system dialog the phone can swallow, and Undo brings the song back with its file, its plays and its place in every playlist.
The message bar can be flicked up out of the way, and it is announced to a screen reader.

Ask SideCut sits in the Home header and on the multi-select bar. Say what you want in your own words - make a playlist from these songs, crossfade 6 seconds, DJ mode on - and it shows the plan before anything changes, then does it with one tap and an Undo.

Home bubbles have the size that was missing: Medium sits between automatic and tall, and the height steppers move in half steps now, so the middle size exists instead of a cardful of empty space or a card that is too small.
Resetting covers, merging into an existing album and the update prompt all ask in the app, so no system dialog is left anywhere.
